# PharmaCare

> Fast, private POS and inventory management desktop software built for modern retail pharmacies and medical stores.

PharmaCare is a 100% offline-first Windows desktop application designed to streamline billing, track drug expiration, manage inventory, and provide daily sales revenue analytics without cloud lock-in.

## Key Features

- [Speed POS & Fast Billing](https://pharmacarex.vercel.app/#features): Quick medicine search, keyboard shortcuts, and instant thermal / PDF receipt printing.
- [3-Tier Expiry & Stock Radar](https://pharmacarex.vercel.app/#features): Automated alerts for expiring soon, low stock, and out-of-stock items.
- [Offline SQLite Database](https://pharmacarex.vercel.app/#features): Full local data ownership and privacy with optional Dropbox cloud synchronization.
- [Sales Analytics & Margin Tracking](https://pharmacarex.vercel.app/#features): Real-time daily revenue graphs and gross profit margin tracking.
- [Bulk CSV Import & Export](https://pharmacarex.vercel.app/#features): Easily import medicine catalogs and export reports in CSV format.
- [Custom Themes & GST Invoicing](https://pharmacarex.vercel.app/#features): Multi-theme support (Dark Mode) with customizable receipt headers and GST details.

## Technical Details

- Platform: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Architecture: Offline-first desktop application with local SQLite database
- Current Version: v0.2.1
- License: Free
